row.proto: void *Career_Timeline_FindEntryFromDay(void *vm, char want_kind, uint16_t from_day, uint8_t inclusive)
row.notes: myteam-g2: Scans the advance timeline entry list (vm+0x50..+0x58) for entries of the registered type whose day (ushort at +10) is after from_day (or equal if inclusive) and whose id is in the team set (vm+0x20); returns the first match. Used for next-event lookups in TeamHqAdvance/MyTeam VMs and the R&D goto-department button.

verify.notes: V9692 Scans +0x50..0x58 list, day ushort +10, id in set at +0x20; kind byte compared at +0x10; matches.
